input.heading: Black Friday: 50% off professional whitening
input.content: Get a brighter, whiter smile for the holidays. For Black Friday only, professional in-office teeth whitening at Bright Smile Dental is half price. Spots are limited, so book your appointment today.

input.heading: Frequently asked questions
input.content:
Q: How long does a whitening appointment take?
A: About 60–90 minutes in our office.

Q: Is professional whitening safe?
A: Yes. Whitening is done under the supervision of our dental team, using products made for safe, even results.

Q: Will my teeth be sensitive afterwards?
A: Some patients feel mild, temporary sensitivity. We'll go over ways to minimise it at your visit.

Q: How long do the results last?
A: Results usually last 1–3 years, depending on diet and home care.

Q: How do I claim the Black Friday offer?
A: Book your whitening appointment during the Black Friday promotion and the 50% discount is applied automatically.
